about: The postcommunion of the Third Sunday of Advent asks that divine help cleanse us of our vices and prepare us for the coming feasts.

seg.tr: We implore Your clemency, O Lord, that these divine aids may prepare us, cleansed of our vices, for the feasts to come. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who lives and reigns with You
